summary: Tested 'El universo de mi mascota' Phase 1 end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest passing (pets meta, create/validation/auth, photo owner/non-owner, reveal with real Claude + photo-required + non-owner, list isolation, get non-owner 404, creations shape+non-owner, portrait pet_id persisted + non-owned ignored). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): 25/25 flow checks passing — landing headline + CTAs visible without login, Universe (/universo) shows intro + 3 invitations + memorial link + pet picker (Rocco seed), full onboarding flow (name+species+photo → traits → skip memory → AI reveal in ~10s → Entrar al universo → /universo), regression /retrato /crear /hablar /recuerdo /mis-creaciones all load for logged-in user, /r/:slug public portrait loads without login.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1346 lines — approaching the 700-line split guideline; consider extracting pet, portrait, story, talk routers into submodules.
pet_public and pet_creations fetch pet via get_pet twice in some flows — minor; not a bug.
Portrait POST returns only {id,slug} (no pet_id echoed back) — considered checking persistence via mongo in tests; frontend uses GET /pets/{id}/creations instead, which is fine.
test_credentials: Bearer test_session_norm_1 (user_testnorm1), Bearer test_session_admin_1 (user_testadmin1). Pet Rocco id=a8f1f1bb-e5ef-4854-b07e-dc438112bd4a. Frontend: localStorage.petito_token='test_session_norm_1'.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_Luna, TEST_NoPhoto, TEST_AdminPet, TEST_UILuna pets and 2 portraits under norm user. These remain in test_database.pets and test_database.portraits. Non-destructive; do not interfere with Rocco seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 'CTA logged-out routes to /login' expectation is INCORRECT: RequireAuth renders <Login/> INLINE and the URL stays at /bienvenida — this is by-design and matches the comment in Landing.jsx line 30. To verify auth-gating in future, check for Login-screen elements, not URL change. Reveal takes ~10s via real Claude; tests use a 40s timeout and succeed first try. Portrait creation returns {id,slug} only — to verify pet_id persistence, query Mongo (pymongo) directly as done in test_pets_universe.py. Pytest must be run with -o addopts='' to disable the project's xdist loadscope config (worker isolation breaks the shared pytest.created_pet_id attribute).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Single test assertion was corrected mentally (not re-run) because the real-app behavior is correct (inline Login via RequireAuth).
